sections.title: Machine Learning Applications for Atlanta Organizations
sections.description: Production ML solutions for Atlanta's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Payments and FinTech ML (Transaction Alley)
paragraphs: For NCR Corporation (Atlanta HQ), Global Payments (Atlanta HQ), FleetCor Technologies (Atlanta HQ), and the Transaction Alley payments ecosystem:

Real-time payment fraud ML: Sub-100ms transaction risk scoring for Global Payments' and NCR's massive transaction processing volumes — combining merchant network signals, cardholder behavioral features, device fingerprinting, and velocity checks for the multi-billion annual transaction volumes that Atlanta's payment processors handle.
Fleet card fraud analytics: ML for FleetCor's commercial fleet card portfolio — detecting unusual fuel purchase patterns, unauthorized card use, and driver behavior anomalies at fleet scale.

Merchant risk and underwriting: ML for merchant account underwriting — predicting chargeback risk, business viability, and processing volume stability for the merchant acquiring operations at Global Payments and NCR's payment services division.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | PCI DSS context, real-time ML

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical ML
paragraphs: For Emory Healthcare (Atlanta HQ), Grady Health System, Piedmont Healthcare, and the Children's Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA):

Clinical deterioration prediction: Sepsis early warning, acute kidney injury risk, and clinical deterioration prediction for Emory's Epic-integrated system and Grady's high-acuity urban trauma population.
CHOA pediatric ML: Population health and care management ML for Children's Healthcare of Atlanta's large pediatric patient population — Georgia's largest children's health system.
Georgia Medicaid analytics: Population health risk stratification for the managed care organizations serving Georgia's CMO (Care Management Organization) Medicaid program.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA, Georgia DCH

blocks.heading: Media and Entertainment ML
paragraphs: For CNN (Atlanta HQ), Turner Broadcasting, and the Cox Media Group headquartered in the Atlanta metro:
Content recommendation: ML for CNN Digital and Turner's streaming properties — personalizing content recommendation across CNN.com's large digital audience and Turner's cable entertainment portfolio.
Audience analytics: Viewership prediction, subscriber churn, and audience segmentation for Atlanta's media companies managing large audience relationships.
Ad targeting ML: Audience targeting and campaign performance prediction for the digital advertising programs of Atlanta's media companies.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Supply Chain and Logistics ML
paragraphs: For Home Depot (Atlanta HQ), UPS (Atlanta suburb), and Delta Air Lines (Atlanta HQ):

Retail supply chain forecasting: ML for Home Depot's enormous home improvement product demand — incorporating housing market data, weather patterns, and the home improvement spending cycles that drive Home Depot's US market.

Logistics network optimization: ML for UPS's Atlanta hub operations and the air/ground integrated network centered on UPS's Worldport in Louisville (accessible Atlanta market) and Atlanta's own UPS ground hub.
Airline operations ML: Delta's flight schedule optimization, maintenance prediction, and crew scheduling ML from Atlanta's world-busiest airport.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks
